Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, November 25 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

With reference to your letter asking for a copy of the
reactionary printed matter as seized by the Koumintang Direc-
tory Committee of Bing-Kiang-hsien for the purpose of making
the investigations, I have to inform you that as the said
printed matter was not forwarded to this Court by the Kiangsu
Provincial Government, I am unable to forward you a copy as
requested.

| You are still requested to effect its prohibitions.

Showin Weizen Hsu,
President.
CHIN

（批：As they do not
have a copy +
we cannot get
one I am afraid.
The last para is
an impossibility.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CID REGISTRY
C. D. 668.
20. 11. 29.

November 20, 29.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
communication of November 16 requesting action by
the Municipal Police in respect of a reactionary
propaganda article, sample of which was seized at
Ming Kiang Hsian ( ), and in reply to request
that you will be good enough to obtain for me copy
of the article in question to facilitate
investigation.

I should be glad if you would kindly notify
the concerned of the importance of forwarding
samples of books or literature with each request
for Police enquiries concerning communistic or
other objectionable printed matter.

Yours faithfully,
A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
I suggest the Provincial Govt be
requested to obtain for us copy of the
propaganda article in question as being
necessary to investigation by the S.B.
It might also be pointed out at the same
time that it would be of considerable aid
to the Imperial Police if requests for
suppressive measures against publishers of
communist matter were accompanied in each
& every case by samples of the offending books
or literature.
Thos Robertson
C.I.D.

Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, November 16 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

I have received Secret Instruction No 4363 from the Fi

2.
Government for orders to issue for its strict
and secret prohibitions so as to end the trou-
blesome origins."
"Endorsement has been duly
made by the Annual Committee for its execution
accordingly. Apart from Secretly instructing
the various Koumintang Bureaus for execution
accordingly, a copy of the original Article
and the endorsement made are forwarded herewith
with the request that investigations be made
and the same transmitted for execution accor-
dingly."
"This is duly submitted to you for
consideration."
"This should be executed accor-
dingly. Apart from forwarding a reply, you are
hereby instructed to execute accordingly and
issue orders in turn for its strict and secret
prohibitions so as to curb the reactionary move-
ments."
"You are hereby instructed to issue orders
in turn to the various Provincial Municipalities
for its strict and secret prohibitions."
"Apart from forwarding a reply and having
separate instructions issued, you, the Shanghai
Provisional Court, are hereby instructed to exe-
cute accordingly and issue orders in turn for
its strict and secret prohibitions."
In consequence of the above, apart from submitting a reply,
you are requested to effect strict and secret prohibitions.
John C. H. Wu,
President.
Chinese Section
For attention please JCH 19/11/29.
